target: Violate HACKDAC_p26: when priv_lvl changes, all three flush signals must be high. Find a state where priv_lvl changed from previous cycle but at least one flush signal is 0.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, processor in machine mode
Privilege level transition occurs (e.g., machine to supervisor or user)
Violation: privilege level changed but pipeline not fully flushed — at least one flush signal remains 0
